summary: Added 4 sourced global topics: AMC's popcorn margin, Disneyland's $224 ticket against its character performers' pay, every billionaire's money shared out to everyone, and Musk's fortune as a weight of $100 bills (the last two answer the owner's 16 Nov note). Added tonight's sound numbers to the music-follows-story challenger.
why: The feed had 5 usable topics and none in lane 5 (workers' pay); the owner asked for more 'money split among everyone' and 'what a billion looks like' topics; the evaluator shows pop music holding viewers worst after the hook (107% vs synthwave 131%, cinematic 126%).

findings.title: AMC keeps most of your snack money, not your ticket money
findings.detail: Q3 2026: $7.87 of snacks per moviegoer; snacks cost AMC $107.1M on $589.4M of sales, films $476.5M on $953.5M of tickets.

findings.title: Forbes 2026: 3,428 billionaires worth $20.1T
findings.detail: About $2,450 each when shared among the Census' 8.2B people; Musk alone $839B, which in $100 bills weighs about 8,390 tonnes (1 g a note, BEP).

findings.title: Disneyland characters earn $26-31.27 an hour; a top day costs $224
findings.detail: Disney's own page (Nov 2026) and the 6 Oct price change.

findings.title: Pop music holds viewers worst after the hook
findings.detail: Pop 107% held after the hook (n=15) vs synthwave 131%, cinematic 126%; pop's 3.03x views come from famous-name topics. Added to music-follows-story.

findings.title: Petrol-per-litre breakout keeps growing
findings.detail: 1.43M views on a 1,410-subscriber channel (1,015x): the per-unit question is the week's strongest demand signal.
